name: Spirit creation
summary: Extra materials improve creation rank and level; created ranks remain fixed.
instructions: For a base ingredient quantity q, rank boosts +1/+2/+3/+4 require ceil(1.5q), 2q, 3q and 5q of that ingredient. For q=1, two pieces already give +2, three or four give +3, five give +4. Apply the smaller boost of the two ingredients; Risky Winds adds one further rank, capped at ★. Total materials grant ceil(total/3) bonus starting levels, capped at 20. Marked recipe-item formulas guarantee their intended breed. A donated command is consumed; Movement/Defense donations require retaining another copy. Exact command bonuses are recorded in the factual catalog.
uncertainty: The source initial-level table contains inconsistent cells (average level 20 → 27; 30–01 range). Risky Winds describes a 50% odds change without clarifying relative versus percentage-point arithmetic. These defects prevent a certified level/odds optimizer.

name: Spirit stats
summary: Rank, breed, level and a creation-time random value determine base stats.
instructions: Base stat × (rank correction + random value) × level correction ÷ 10. Rank corrections are ★1.18, A1.12, B1.06, C1, D0.94, E0.88 and F0.82. Random value ranges from (correction−1.1)/10 to (correction−0.9)/10. Level correction is 10+level through 50, then 35+level/2. Forecast adds further stat bonuses. Missing breed values stay unknown.

name: HD training controls
summary: Balloon, Water Barrel and Candy Goggles use HD controls.
instructions: PS4 reference bindings: Balloon uses the touch pad to return balloons; good timing scores 3, early timing 1. Water Barrel uses L1/R1 flippers and L2/R2 jets; collect prizes before each pattern expires. Candy Goggles aims with the left stick: R1 fires red and L1 blue; match each Spirit’s request. Slow, medium and fast targets award 10, 20 and 30. Balloon gives affinity/EXP, Water Barrel EXP/LP, Candy Goggles affinity/LP. Paint Guns change appearance only. Treat consumption depends on happiness, food preference and Affinity Gain; uneaten treats are reconsidered every 3–7 seconds.
uncertainty: PS4 control names are source labels. Steam keyboard and other-controller bindings are not documented by this source; use the configured on-screen prompts.

name: Reality Shift
summary: World-specific field and battle interactions use marked targets.
instructions: HD PS4 activation is Triangle + Circle when a pink target appears. It pauses the action for the Shift. International layouts can also spend the selected deck command on activation, so choose it deliberately. Worlds use Slingshot (Traverse Town), Faithline (La Cité), Code Break (Grid), Bubble Burst (Prankster’s Paradise), Wonder Comic (Musketeers), Melody Catcher (Symphony), and Nightmare’s End/Mirage Split (The World That Never Was). Dreamline is a separate story crossing.
uncertainty: Individual technique pages retain 3DS touch instructions and lack a complete Steam input crosswalk; no touch gestures are presented as PC controls.

name: Secret ending
summary: Another Guardian of Light is a separate Theater unlock.
instructions: The published criteria require in-game trophies: Beginner 13, Standard 7, Proud 5, Critical 0. After Armored Ventus Nightmare, choose the answers about losing something important, close friends, and recovering something important. Beginner/Standard also need every golden credits letter. Replay credits through Mementos → Theater for another letter attempt; the ending appears in Theater instead of playing automatically.
uncertainty: The page covers DDD and HD but does not independently document every HD retry combination after incorrect final answers; full recovery certification remains bounded.

name: Clear data
summary: Clear data opens Critical, Secret Portals, Julius and NG+.
instructions: NG+ transfers Spirit instances and affinity, trophy shelf progress, Story, Glossary, Character Files and Mementos. Spirit levels and Ability Link boards reset; Game Records and Treasures reset. Keep the original clear save before beginning a new run.
